description: A formula_spec whose AST node count exceeds MAX_FORMULA_NODES (10000). The adapter must reject it with SmtError (CONTRACT_INVALID) before the solver is constructed. This case is generated, not hand-authored; the generator runs at gate time to avoid committing a 10000+ node JSON blob.
notes: The gate materializes the formula by repeating `operand` under an `and` `repeat` times (12000 > 10000 = MAX_FORMULA_NODES) and asserts check() raises SmtError. The committed fixture carries only the generator, not the inflated spec, so the corpus stays reviewable.
